items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bunk Johnston's career and associations (playing with 'it', being a band leader, playing for Billika Sam). The interviewee only confirms details about Billika Sam ('Said a lot of jokes', 'Billika Sam made her laugh') but does not claim any personal interaction, collaboration

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Bunk played with it.

Bunk played with it. Yeah. Bunk Johnston played carnette with him. Bunk Johnston played carnette in that band. In fact, Bunk Johnston was a band leader. I don't remember what that was. And Bunk Johnston's band played for Billika Sam. Billika Sam didn't play music. But he sang. He used to sing.
